item.title: Authorities locate wanted man dead after hours-long standoff in Burke County
item.description: A man wanted on multiple felony charges was reportedly found dead inside a Hildebran home following a SWAT situation.

item.title: Man arrested after being accused of armed robbery in South End, firing shots at CMPD officers
item.description: Officers responded to the 500 block of Summit Avenue shortly after 3:20 a.m. Feb. 6 in reference to an armed robbery call.

item.title: Gov. Stein signs order to strengthen NC mental health systems in wake of Iryna Zarutska killing
item.description: The executive order expands the co-responder model, in which social workers and medical professionals respond to mental health calls, rather than sworn officers.

item.title: Charlotte activists raise concerns over proposed I‑77 South expansion, community meeting cut short due to uproar
item.description: The director of a mental health nonprofit said displacement would have lasting consequences.

item.title: Temperatures fall again for windy start to weekend
item.description: A Wind Advisory continues for most of the region, with gusts to 45 mph possible.

item.title: West Morehead Street shut down 'until further notice' as water main repair progresses
item.description: Charlotte Water crews are working to repair dozens of broken pipes throughout the city due to fluctuating temperatures, causing traffic delays and water outages for nearby businesses.

item.title: Pedestrian struck and killed by car on The Plaza in Charlotte
item.description: Traffic is blocked in both directions on The Plaza at the scene.

item.title: Woman fatally shot at Bank of America branch in northwest Charlotte: CMPD
item.description: The deadly incident happened shortly after 10:30 a.m. Friday at a local Bank of America branch in the 9700 block of Callabridge Court, an area surrounded by several local businesses.

item.title: Charlotte leaders 'in the hot seat' Monday to discuss DEI, light rail stabbing with NC House committee
item.description: CMPD data showed that in 2025, violent crime was down 21 percent from 2024.
